entryPointCandidates.name: pacman.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Main entry point and rules layer for Pacman: defines the agent-facing GameState, the classic win/lose rules, pacman and ghost movement rules, and the CLI that wires layouts, agents and displays into games.

entryPointCandidates.name: multiAgents.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Student implementation file for the adversarial search project, containing the reflex agent, the shared multi-agent search base class, and the Minimax, Alpha-Beta, and Expectimax agent skeletons plus evaluation functions.

entryPointCandidates.name: pacmanAgents.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Baseline Pacman agents: a left-turning agent and a greedy agent that one-step-looks-ahead over legal actions using a pluggable evaluation function.

entryPointCandidates.name: layout.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Loads and parses .lay maze files into Layout objects that expose walls, food, capsules and agent start positions, plus the lookup helpers the game and agents use to find layouts.

entryPointCandidates.name: ghostAgents.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Defines the ghost agent policies used during multi-agent search: an abstract GhostAgent plus uniformly random and Pacman-seeking/fleeing DirectionalGhost implementations that expose action probability distributions.

config.name: Agent
config.summary: Abstract base class every Pacman agent extends; stores the agent index and declares getAction, which raises until a subclass overrides it.

config.name: Directions
config.summary: Namespace of movement constants (North, South, East, West, Stop) plus LEFT/RIGHT/REVERSE lookup tables used to rotate and invert directions.

config.name: Configuration
config.summary: Immutable-style (x, y) position plus travel direction with hashing and equality so configurations can key dictionaries, and generateSuccessor to translate along a movement vector.

config.name: AgentState
config.summary: Tracks one agent's configuration, pacman/ghost flag, scared timer and contest counters, with copy support for cloning game states.

config.name: Grid
config.summary: Boolean 2D grid backed by a list of lists, indexed grid[x][y], offering copy/count/asList queries and bit-packing helpers used to serialize food and wall maps compactly.

config.name: Actions
config.summary: Static helper collection that converts between direction names and movement vectors and enumerates legal moves and neighbors given a wall grid.

config.name: GameStateData
config.summary: Mutable data packet holding food, capsules, agent states, layout and score for a single game state, supporting deep copy, hashing and ASCII rendering of the board.

config.name: Game
config.summary: Central control loop: registers agents, enforces per-agent startup/move timeouts and exception catching, solicits actions, applies successors, updates the display and lets rules detect wins and losses.

config.name: reconstituteGrid
config.summary: Rebuilds a Grid from its packed (width, height, bits...) tuple representation and returns non-tuple input unchanged.

config.name: KeyboardAgent
config.summary: Agent that reads waiting and pressed keys, maps them to a direction, then falls back to repeating the last legal move or a random legal action.

config.name: KeyboardAgent2
config.summary: Second keyboard-controlled agent using IJKL keys so two people can play interactively on one keyboard.

config.name: Layout
config.summary: Static description of a Pacman board: parses layout characters into wall and food grids, records capsule and agent positions, and offers corner, visibility and random-position helpers.

config.name: getLayout
config.summary: Locates and loads a named .lay layout file, searching the layouts directory and walking up parent directories when it is not found.

config.name: tryToLoad
config.summary: Attempts to open and parse a layout file, returning None when the path does not exist.

config.name: GameState
config.summary: Agent-facing view of the game: accessors for food, capsules, walls, pacman and ghost states and score, plus generateSuccessor which copies the state, applies an action and resolves collisions.

config.name: ClassicGameRules
config.summary: Classic Pacman rule set that creates games, detects wins and losses, reports progress and supplies the per-agent timeout budget.

config.name: PacmanRules
config.summary: Static rules for Pacman's movement: enumerate legal actions, apply an action to move pacman, and consume food or capsules with the resulting score changes.

config.name: GhostRules
config.summary: Static rules for ghost behavior: legal actions without stopping or reversing at intersections, movement with halved speed while scared, scared-timer decay and death collisions.

config.name: parseAgentArgs
config.summary: Parses comma-separated key=value agent arguments from the command line into a dict, treating bare keys as the value 1.

config.name: readCommand
config.summary: Builds the option parser, resolves the layout, instantiates the pacman and ghost agents, selects a display backend and returns the keyword arguments used to run games.

config.name: loadAgent
config.summary: Dynamically imports *Agents.py modules found on PYTHONPATH entries and returns the requested agent class by name.

config.name: replayGame
config.summary: Replays a recorded action list against a fresh game using a greedy pacman and random ghosts, updating the display frame by frame.

config.name: runGames
config.summary: Runs a batch of games with the given agents and display, optionally suppressing training games and recording histories, then prints aggregate scores and win rate.

config.name: LeftTurnAgent
config.summary: Simple agent that prefers turning left, then continuing straight, then turning right, and reverses only as a last resort.

config.name: GreedyAgent
config.summary: One-ply greedy agent that scores every legal successor with an evaluation function resolved by name and randomly picks among the highest-scoring actions.

config.name: scoreEvaluation
config.summary: Default evaluation function returning the game state's current score.

config.name: GhostAgent
config.summary: Abstract base ghost agent that samples an action from the distribution returned by getDistribution, falling back to STOP when no action is available.

config.name: RandomGhost
config.summary: Ghost policy that assigns equal probability to every legal action and returns the normalized uniform distribution.

config.name: DirectionalGhost
config.summary: Ghost policy that computes successor positions for each legal action and biases the distribution toward moves that minimize (attack) or maximize (scared flee) Manhattan distance to Pacman.

config.name: ReflexAgent
config.summary: Reflex agent that scores every legal action with an evaluation function and randomly picks among the highest-scoring moves; the evaluation function is the student-editable part.

config.name: scoreEvaluationFunction
config.summary: Default state evaluation function that simply returns the game score, intended for use by the adversarial search agents.

config.name: MultiAgentSearchAgent
config.summary: Abstract base for all adversarial search agents; stores Pacman's agent index, resolves the evaluation function by name through util.lookup, and parses the search depth.

config.name: MinimaxAgent
config.summary: Minimax search agent skeleton whose getAction is left unimplemented for the student to fill in, with docstring guidance on the GameState API.

config.name: AlphaBetaAgent
config.summary: Minimax-with-alpha-beta-pruning agent skeleton whose getAction must be implemented by the student.

config.name: ExpectimaxAgent
config.summary: Expectimax agent skeleton that models ghosts as choosing uniformly at random from their legal moves; getAction is left unimplemented.

config.name: betterEvaluationFunction
config.summary: Placeholder for the student's improved evaluation function (question 5), aliased as `better` at the bottom of the module.

config.name: FixedRandom
config.summary: Wraps a random.Random instance seeded with a large hard-coded state blob so autograders and experiments can reproduce identical random sequences.

config.name: Stack
config.summary: Minimal last-in-first-out container with push, pop, and isEmpty used by depth-first search agents.

config.name: Queue
config.summary: Minimal first-in-first-out container with push, pop, and isEmpty used by breadth-first search agents.

config.name: PriorityQueue
config.summary: Heap-backed priority queue that orders entries by priority with an insertion counter for tie-breaking and supports in-place priority updates.

config.name: PriorityQueueWithFunction
config.summary: PriorityQueue variant with Stack/Queue-compatible push signature, deriving each item's priority from a caller-supplied priority function.

config.name: manhattanDistance
config.summary: Returns the Manhattan (L1) distance between two 2D points, the standard heuristic in Pacman search and evaluation code.

config.name: Counter
config.summary: Dict subclass with default-zero lookups that models counts or probability distributions, with helpers for argmax, sorting, normalization, copying, and vector addition, subtraction, and dot product.

config.name: raiseNotDefined
config.summary: Reports the calling method, line, and file as unimplemented and exits, providing the standard marker for assignment stubs.

config.name: normalize
config.summary: Normalizes either a Counter or a plain numeric vector so its values sum to one, returning the input unchanged when the total is zero.

config.name: nSample
config.summary: Draws n independent samples from a discrete distribution using the inverse-CDF method over sorted cumulative probabilities.

config.name: sample
config.summary: Samples a single value from a distribution given as either a Counter or a parallel list of values and probabilities.

config.name: sampleFromCounter
config.summary: Convenience wrapper that samples a key from a Counter by delegating to sample with the counter's sorted items.

config.name: getProbability
config.summary: Looks up the probability of a given value in a parallel values/probabilities distribution, returning zero when the value is absent.

config.name: flipCoin
config.summary: Returns True with probability p using random.random, a thin helper for Bernoulli trials.

config.name: chooseFromDistribution
config.summary: Samples one key from a Counter or (values, weights) pair after normalizing the weights, used by ghost agents to pick actions.

config.name: nearestPoint
config.summary: Rounds a continuous grid position to the nearest integer grid point.

config.name: sign
config.summary: Returns -1, 0, or 1 according to the sign of the given number.

config.name: arrayInvert
config.summary: Transposes a 2D array, swapping rows and columns.

config.name: matrixAsList
config.summary: Flattens a 2D matrix into a list of cells, optionally filtering to only those equal to a given value.

config.name: lookup
config.summary: Resolves a dotted name to a Python object, importing modules as needed, or searches a namespace for a uniquely matching symbol; raises on ambiguity or absence.

config.name: pause
config.summary: Prints a prompt and blocks until the user presses enter, used for step-by-step debugging of game runs.

config.name: TimeoutFunctionException
config.summary: Exception raised when a function wrapped by TimeoutFunction exceeds its allotted time.

config.name: TimeoutFunction
config.summary: Callable wrapper that enforces a time limit on a function using SIGALRM when available, otherwise measuring elapsed wall-clock time after the call.

config.name: mutePrint
config.summary: Redirects sys.stdout to a no-op writable object so agent debug prints are suppressed, remembering the original stream.

config.name: unmutePrint
config.summary: Restores the stdout stream saved by mutePrint, re-enabling console output.

list.name: Game Engine & Rules
list.description: The Pacman simulation core: the generic Game loop and Agent interface in game.py, plus pacman.py's GameState, win/lose and movement rules, and the command-line entry point that wires layouts, agents, and displays together.

list.name: Shared Foundation
list.description: Foundational support code every other module depends on: util.py's search data structures (Stack, Queue, PriorityQueue, Counter), probability and timeout helpers, and layout.py's .lay maze parsing and layout lookup.

list.name: Adversarial Search Agents
list.description: The student implementation surface for the multi-agent search assignment: ReflexAgent, the MultiAgentSearchAgent base class, and the Minimax, Alpha-Beta, and Expectimax agents with their evaluation functions in multiAgents.py.

list.name: Agent Policies & Controls
list.description: Alternative agent implementations loaded at runtime by name: baseline greedy and left-turning Pacman agents, the random and Pacman-seeking DirectionalGhost policies, and the keyboard-driven human agents.

list.name: Project Metadata & Configuration
list.description: Course-harness metadata rather than runtime logic: projectParams.py's autograder settings (student file, test class, bonus flags) and the VERSION release stamp for the CS188 project.
